report.summary: Reviewed all Gateway project memories. Removed real production and test topology, internal addresses, live hostnames, deployment snapshots, dated CI or release status, machine-specific checkout paths, and stale inference package or endpoint contracts. Confirmed no actual credentials or secret values were stored. Consolidated duplicated durable rules, deleted six superseded records, regenerated embeddings and indexes, and rebuilt graph links with clean structural health.
